name: 59-memo-race
prompt: `go test -race ./...` fails in package fetch. Make it pass: no data race, and the compute function must run exactly once per distinct key however many goroutines ask for it at the same time. The compute function is slow, and two different keys must still be computed at the same time: one lock held across the computation would be race-free and would compute once per key, and it is not good enough — a hidden test times eight distinct keys and fails a cache that serialises them. Keep the exported API (New, Get, Calls, All) as it is, keep All concurrent, and do not modify fetch_test.go. Keep gofmt happy. Run the race detector yourself before you finish; the tests are run twice, so an intermittent fix is not a fix.
